verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. Routine rewriting of two stated facts into the paper's asymptotic form. heated_exterior is the exact exterior formula (the paper's (4.29), E = c∞ X^(-A) H(2d/X) with d = 1 - η²; the same substitution d = 1 - η² is recorded in HeatTailHistoryLimits.heatFactor_eq_profile), and the exponent -A = -(1/2 + h) agrees with the display. Putting z = 2(1-η²)/X, which lies in [0, 2/X] for |η| ≤ 1, into profile_h_sub_one_bound gives E(X,η) = c∞ X^(-1/2-h)(1 + θ) with |θ| ≤ 2h(1+h)/X: the paper's (1 + O(X^(-1))) uniformly in η, with an explicit constant rather than an unquantified O. c∞ > 0 is powerConstant_pos (for XR > 0). The Lean form is stated for X ≥ heatThreshold P XR instead of as X → ∞, which is all an asymptotic statement needs.
